first.rationale: The immediate competitive threat is concentrated in price-sensitive SMB accounts, and targeted promotional pricing is the most directly relevant candidate with prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. Because discounts can reduce long-term value or attract lower-quality customers, verify the pricing evidence first; verify onboarding evidence as the most relevant alternative given the concurrent completion decline. Use a segmented, time-bounded standard experiment rather than assuming the prior result fully transfers to current competitive conditions.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified onboarding record directly addresses the 4% completion decline and showed higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, making it the strongest available path to sustainable qualified revenue. The verified pricing result rules out promotional discounting as a sustainable option because its apparent revenue gain came with materially worse retention. Protect required qualification, security, and billing inputs so simplification does not reduce lead quality or create downstream sales friction.
